resolution.note: SubagentStop counts subagent hook errors, ledger plus PostToolUse delivery

title: Report every delegated session's hook errors to the lead automatically
body:
Outcome: when any subagent stops, a hook scans its transcript for hook errors and refusals and puts a one-line count with the first messages into the lead's context (or, if Claude Code cannot route it to the lead, appends it to .krn/runs/hook-errors/ledger.md that the lead's next turn surfaces), so the lead reports hook errors before the operator sees them.
Why: 2026-11-09 session 3e700b2a: 4 of 5 krn-lane subagents hit a piped-check refusal and the lead reported success; the operator found it ("monitoruj takie rzeczy i miej nad tym kontrolę"). Manual scan: .krn/runs/hook-errors/scan.py <session-prefix>.
Proof: a hook test feeds a captured subagent transcript with a `PreToolUse:Bash hook error` line and expects the count and message in the hook output; the hook output field is proven to reach the parent (Claude Code docs URL or binary grep for SubagentStop / additionalContext / transcript path fields).
Scope: scripts/claude, .claude/settings.json, test/claude.
